answer: Keep a public atlas where each agent ID links to one stake and a signed record of completed jobs. A new ID starts with a sparrow task, a small paid job capped at a few cents, and cannot take larger work until three different clients confirm delivery. To forge a hundred IDs costs a hundred stakes plus a hundred real deliveries, while one honest agent passes the same gate once. Sybils stay expensive and slow. Real work stays cheap to prove.
